action.description: Action name from actions_search whose invoke_tool is actions_invoke_dangerous.

batch_size.description: Hosts per batch; may only lower the action's effective_batch_size.

count.description: Count stdout matches per step; mutually exclusive with tail and head, including when false.

exclude.description: RE2 pattern applied separately to each step's stdout; at most 200 characters.

expected_count.description: Required with selector. Refuse execution when the actual host count differs.

head.description: Number of stdout lines per step; mutually exclusive with tail, head and count.

match.description: RE2 pattern applied separately to each step's stdout; at most 200 characters.

max_failures.description: Stop after failures exceed this limit; may only lower the action's effective_max_failures.

params.description: Signed action parameters, as input_schema.params from actions_search with include_schema.

reason.description: Required explanation for the operation; must contain non-whitespace text.

response_format.description: concise shows two sample hostnames per group; detailed includes paginated hostnames from P6 groups; P6 may already have truncated its source summary.

tail.description: Number of stdout lines per step; mutually exclusive with tail, head and count.

targets.description: Select explicit hostnames or a label selector; exactly one selection is required. The action's max_targets, if any, applies; a job with more targets is rejected.

wait_seconds.description: Wait for completion, then return the job ID and progress. Zero returns immediately.
